Lab 2 Walkthrough - IT asset inventory (Part A) + conformity assessment plan (Part B) - 420-D04-AB - CYB-01 - due Sun Nov 15, 2026, 23:59 EST
Step 0A1A2A3A4-A5A7B1-B2B3B4-B6Submit

Lab-only demonstration. All screens are self-made illustrations with fictional data (Erable Cycles inc.). Run the commands only on your own lab VMs and your own lab subnet, with the signed authorization letter (Annex A). Mask any real personal information in your evidence. Use subject to the Cyber.SoHo Legal Notice, Terms of Use and Acceptable Use Policy v2.0 (6.1, 6.4, 6.7, 7.5, 7.6, 18) - unauthorized use of a computer is an offence under the Criminal Code, s. 342.1. Content checked against versions available at the end of October 2026; footnotes flag what may look different.

Step 0 - Snapshot, host-only network, Nmap

  • Take the snapshot Lab2-start of both VMs (virtual machines): your rollback point (Legal Notice 6.4).
  • Put both VMs on the same host-only network and note the subnet (here 192.168.56.0/24).
  • Install Nmap on Ubuntu and check its version.
ip -br a
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y nmap
nmap --version

1 Version note: Ubuntu 24.04 packages an Nmap 7.94-based build; the upstream release is 7.99 (March 26, 2026). Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (April 2026) packages 7.98. All of them support -sn. Interface names (enp0s3, enp0s8) depend on the hypervisor.

A1 - Windows VM row (PowerShell)

  • Collect host name, OS version and build, IPv4 address, installed-program count, top 10 programs and running services.
  • Save the screenshots as L2-E01 and L2-E02 and list them in Evidence_index.
Get-ComputerInfo | Select-Object CsName, OsName, OsVersion, OsBuildNumber
Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object InterfaceAlias -notmatch 'Loopback' | Select-Object InterfaceAlias, IPAddress
$apps = Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*, HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\* | Where-Object DisplayName; $apps.Count
(Get-Service | Where-Object Status -eq 'Running').Count

2 Version note: The build number depends on your evaluation ISO: Windows 11 24H2 = 26100, 25H2 = 26200. Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7.6 give the same values; the window colours differ.

A2 - Ubuntu VM row (Bash)

  • Collect host name, OS, kernel, IP, package count and running services.
  • Save the screenshots as L2-E03 and L2-E04.
hostnamectl
ip -br a
apt list --installed 2>/dev/null | wc -l
systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-pager | head -n 15

3 Version note: Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS (February 2026) uses the 6.17 hardware-enablement kernel; an older 24.04 image shows 6.8. Counts differ from machine to machine - record yours.

A3 - Host discovery on your lab subnet only

  • -sn = host discovery without a port scan; -oN = save the output as evidence L2-E05.
  • Reconcile both ways: every discovered host is in the inventory or explained as lab infrastructure; every VM appears in the scan.
  • Scan only your own lab subnet (Legal Notice 7.6; Criminal Code s. 342.1).
sudo nmap -sn 192.168.56.0/24 -oN L2-E05_nmap_discovery.txt

4 Version note: VirtualBox usually places its DHCP server at .100 of the host-only network and the host adapter at .1; VMware uses other addresses. Use your own subnet.

A4-A5 - Inventory and decision table

  • Fill the 12 columns for the 12 assets in sheet A1 (row A04 is the worked example).
  • Answer Q1-Q4 in order in sheet A2; the formula gives sensitivity and flags; column H must say OK.

5 Version note: Excel and LibreOffice Calc both calculate the formulas; if old values appear, press F9 (Excel) or use Data > Calculate > Recalculate Hard (LibreOffice).

A7 - Five critical assets

  • Tick the processes each asset supports and the SPOF (single point of failure) flag in sheet A3.
  • Mark exactly 5 critical assets and write one sentence of rationale each; an owner may override a score with a written reason.

6 Version note: Scores shown are the Day 4 example; yours may differ if your ticks differ.

B1-B2 - Scope and authorization letter

  • Scope = 5 critical assets + 2 VMs; name 2 out-of-scope assets with a reason.
  • Complete Annex A of the plan template (adapted from Annex D of the Legal Notice); sign and date it before Nov 11; give a copy to the instructor.

7 Version note: Role-play letter for a fictional company: it never authorizes tests outside your lab VMs and lab subnet. Not legal advice (Legal Notice 8.1, 16).

B3 - Checklist with the five rules

  • Select 12-15 of the 20 Master Checklist items in sheet B2.
  • Include MC-12, MC-18, MC-19, MC-20 (legal/contractual) and MC-01, MC-02, MC-08 (baselines).
  • Cover every in-scope asset; keep at least 3 configuration and 3 control items.
python3 L3_build_checklist.py # optional: compare with your selection

8 Version note: The example selects 14 items; any selection that passes the rule checks is valid.

B4-B6 - Tests, risk scales, schedule

  • For each item: method, sample (size and how chosen), measurable pass rule, evidence name.
  • Keep the 3x3 matrix: 1-2 Low, 3-4 Medium, 6 High, 9 Critical.
  • Schedule on Days 7-9; scans after 18:00; nothing from Nov 20 (change freeze).
bash L5_schedule_plan.sh # optional: schedule + Lab2B_assessment.ics
python3 L6_plan_assembler.py # optional: readiness /5 and fixes

9 Version note: Calendar import menus change between versions: Outlook (File > Open & Export), Google Calendar (Settings > Import & export), Thunderbird (Events and Tasks > Import).

Submit - Omnivox LEA DropBox

  • Upload LastName_FirstName_420-D04-AB_Lab2.xlsx and .pdf before Sun Nov 15, 2026, 23:59 EST.
  • Keep the confirmation (screenshot or e-mail).

10 Version note: Schematic only - Omnivox menus and labels differ by college and version (for example 'Assignments' or 'Travaux').
